body: U.S. Bank National Association sued 1592 Boston Street LLC on September 10, 2026, seeking to foreclose on the Bostonian Apartments at 1592 Boston St. in Aurora, Colorado, according to BusinessDen's weekly roundup of real estate lawsuits. The bank says it lent the company $3,280,000 and has not been repaid. The case number is 26CV31801.

The owner had sought bankruptcy protection earlier in the year. Federal court records show 1592 Boston Street LLC filed a Chapter 11 petition in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Colorado on January 9, 2026 (No. 26-10135), the same day a related company, 1960 Dallas Street LLC, filed its own case (No. 26-10134). A motion to dismiss the Boston Street case was filed on May 1, the docket records the dismissal on May 20, and the case was closed on June 23, 2026.

timeline.label: 1592 Boston Street LLC and 1960 Dallas Street LLC file Chapter 11 petitions in the District of Colorado
The 1592 Boston Street Chapter 11 case is dismissed
U.S. Bank files a foreclosure suit against 1592 Boston Street LLC
